mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE MoM > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during a monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a mismatch between supply and demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5% and RSAFS MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 0.5% and UNRATE MoM < -0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < -1% during a monetary tightening cycle.
